recipe.title: Remove unknown and active legal-hold refusals as one current admission control

anchors.find: if (hold.state === "unknown") throw new RepairRefused(`legal hold state unknown: ${hold.reason}`);
if (hold.state === "active") throw new RepairRefused(`legal hold active: ${hold.holdIds.join(", ")}`);

recipe.meaning: Potential fail-closed admission sensitivity under injected legalHolds callbacks and a stub signer. Source permits proceeding after callback unknown/active when both refusals are removed; original case bodies may stop before all state assertions. The returned receipt uses literal legalHold.state none at source:208, but these original failed cases do not independently retain/assert that receipt.
notEstablished: A built CLI hold bypass from a TS-only mutation
Every post-failure filesystem/receipt fact unless separately retained before cleanup
